name: Mercy Killing
overview: Scripture firmly upholds the sanctity of human life, as seen in the clear command not to kill in Exodus 20:13. Even in contexts of suffering and judgment, such as in Revelation 9:5, God restrains killing, emphasizing His sovereign control over life and death. Believers are called to respond to God's mercy by offering themselves wholly to Him, living as holy sacrifices rather than taking life into their own hands, as expressed in Romans 12:1.
